independence: Ground truth was transcribed from original publisher PDFs, independent pypdf text extraction and visual inspection of every Poppler-rendered page. No PaperVault/Docling extraction output was consulted.
counting_policy: One object per independently numbered Figure/Table caption. Multiple panels under a shared caption count as one figure; separately numbered side-by-side figures count separately. References to Figure/Table in body text do not add objects. Scope is numbered objects; unnumbered detections require separate review.
caption_reference_policy: Distinctive opening sentence or short complete caption, transcribed from the source. Whitespace, line-wrap hyphenation and fi/fl ligatures normalized; long captions may be represented by their opening sentence.
